name: hermes-todo
description: 任务备忘录 MOD — 记录当前任务、追踪完成状态、AI 可读写
author: Hermes Desktop

skills.name: todo-list
skills.description: 列出所有备忘录任务及其完成状态

skills.name: todo-add
skills.description: 添加一条新任务。参数: title

skills.name: todo-done
skills.description: 将指定任务标记为已完成。参数: index (任务序号)

skills.name: todo-undo
skills.description: 将已完成任务恢复为未完成。参数: index

skills.name: todo-remove
skills.description: 删除指定任务。参数: index
